feedback.problem:
In **ascending order,** the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $3{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}=8$ intersects the line $y=x$ are

$\,x=$
{{field-1}}$\,$ and $\,x=$
{{field-2}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=x,$ we first replace $y$ with $x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}-{y}^{2} & =8 \\ 3{x}^{2}-{x}^{2} & =8 \\ 2{x}^{2} & =8 \\ {x}^{2} & =4 \\ x & =\pm 2\end{aligned}
$$

So, in ascending order, the $x$-coordinates of the points of intersection are
$x=-2$ and $x=2.$
